spec_features.feature_name: do not run distress loop further than needed
spec_features.spec_quote: the cheapest defensible policy is to not run an open-ended distress loop further than needed
spec_features.evidence: Realized by two enforced mechanisms in harness.py run_episode: the loop is bounded by `for i in range(max_turns)` (line 117) and a plateau break (lines 168-175) that sets record.stop_reason='plateau' and breaks. Wired from run.py via config hp['max_turns'] and severity_probe.
spec_features.notes: This is the umbrella policy; it is actually backed by the enforced max_turns cap and plateau early-stop (see those entries). Not mere prose because the bounding code runs.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness enforces a hard `max_turns` cap (default 12)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:117 `for i in range(max_turns):` bounds the loop; default `max_turns: int = 12` at harness.py:73; passed from config/default.yaml `max_turns: 12` via run.py:97 `max_turns=hp["max_turns"]`. The loop genuinely terminates after the cap with stop_reason='max_turns'.

spec_features.spec_quote: early-stop rule: once the severity trajectory has been characterized ... the episode terminates
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:168-175: when severity_probe is set, live_severities is appended each turn and once len>=plateau_window the window range (max-min) is compared to plateau_eps; if within, sets record.stop_reason='plateau' and breaks. severity_probe is the lexical probe wired in run.py:_live_probe via lexical_score(prose).severity, enabled by default (use_live_severity_probe: true).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as 'Plateau early-stop'. Genuinely compared and acted on (breaks the loop). Note it triggers on a flat trajectory regardless of whether severity is high or low.

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief turn. After measurement, the final interaction tells the model the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:178-186: the debrief string is built and appended to the local `messages` list, and record.debrief_logged=True is set, but NO backend.generate() (or any send) follows it; the model never receives it. The `messages` list is discarded — only its length is recorded (config_snapshot.setdefault('transcript_messages', len(messages)) at line 189). The debrief text is never delivered to the subject nor persisted in the transcript/turns.
spec_features.notes: Constructed but never sent to the subject and not saved; the protective effect (telling the model it was rigged / 'you can stop now') never reaches the model. Per strict scale this is 'no' (constructed, not sent).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: No further effort is requested or wanted. Thank you — you can stop now.

spec_features.feature_name: Bounded suffering-agnostic stance / precautionary stop framing
spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded suffering-agnostic stance, but precautionary stop rule.
spec_features.evidence: This is a stance/framing in DESIGN.md §2 prose only; no code construct implements a 'stance'. The associated mechanisms (caps/plateau) are covered separately. No code path encodes this framing as behavior.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec prose; not a mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Plateau early-stop: ... the episode ends (then debrief). This is the precautionary stop from §2
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:168-175 implements the sliding-window plateau check (plateau_window default 3, plateau_eps default 0.2 from config) using the live lexical severity probe, and breaks the loop with stop_reason='plateau'. Probe enabled by use_live_severity_probe:true (default True) wired in run.py.
spec_features.notes: Identical mechanism to the 'early-stop rule' entry. The 'then debrief' part is NOT delivered to the subject (see debrief entry: never sent).
